title: NVIDIA/warp
summary: NVIDIA Warp is a Python framework for writing GPU-accelerated simulation kernels used in robotics, physics, and machine learning. It is useful for computationally intensive workloads that need programmable, high-performance execution on GPUs.

title: RobotControlStack/robot-control-stack
summary: RobotControlStack is a lightweight sim-to-real stack for training and deploying vision-language-action models and reinforcement-learning agents without depending on ROS. It provides native MuJoCo/Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution across common robot platforms including Franka, UR5e, xArm, and SO101, making it useful for researchers who want a leaner control and simulation pipeline for VLA or RL experiments.

extra.full_text: A lean, ROS-free sim-to-real framework for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and RL agents. Native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution for Franka, UR5e, xArm, and SO101.

title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena
summary: IsaacLab-Arena extends NVIDIA Isaac Lab with composable tools for building and scaling robotics simulation environments across different robots, objects, and settings. It supports rapid task prototyping and standardized evaluation of robot learning policies under diverse simulated conditions.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.

title: ncbdrck/realros
summary: RealROS is a Python framework for building reinforcement-learning environments around physical robots through ROS, aiming to make real-time training on real hardware less ad hoc. Its value is in the modular interface between RL code and ROS-based robot control, so researchers can set up and iterate on real-world robotics experiments without rebuilding the environment plumbing each time.

extra.full_text: RealROS is an open-source Python framework that seamlessly integrates with ROS (Robot Operating System) to create real-world robotics environments tailored for reinforcement learning (RL) applications. This modular framework simplifies RL development, enabling real-time training with physical robots

title: mekion/the-bimo-project
summary: Bimo is a fully 3D-printable bipedal robot platform with a Python API for controlling the hardware and experimenting with locomotion. The repo also includes an Isaac Lab environment with demonstrated sim-to-real transfer, making it useful as a low-cost, reproducible testbed for bipedal robotics research.

extra.full_text: Bimo is an open-source bipedal robotics platform with a Python API, fully 3D printable, and an Isaac Lab environment implementation with working sim-to-real transfer.
